Yes, KLHDC3 is at least twice as long as PSMD10. 

- **KLHDC3** (canonical human protein, UniProt: [Q9BQ90](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9BQ90/entry)) has a length of **382 amino acids**.
- **PSMD10** (canonical human protein, UniProt: [O75832](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O75832/entry)) has a length of **170 amino acids**.

Since 382 amino acids is greater than 2 × 170 amino acids (340 amino acids), KLHDC3 is more than twice as long as PSMD10.
